description: This file contains utility functions for system operations, file handling, command execution, and process management in a Linux environment, used as part of mocks for system_utils in a test framework.

methods.name: int filePresentCheck(const char * file_name)
methods.description: Checks if a specified file exists by calling stat(). Returns 0 if the file exists; -1 otherwise.

methods.name: int cmdExec(const char * cmd,char * output,unsigned int size_buff)
methods.description: Executes a shell command via popen(), reads its output, and stores it in the provided buffer.

methods.name: int getFileSize(const char * file_name)
methods.description: Returns the size of a file in bytes using stat().

methods.name: int logFileData(const char * file_path)
methods.description: Logs the entire contents of a file to the standard log, reading line by line.

methods.name: int createDir(const char * dirname)
methods.description: Creates a directory if it does not exist.

methods.name: int eraseFolderExcePramaFile(const char * folder,const char * file_name,const char * model_num)
methods.description: Deletes files in a folder matching certain patterns, except those matching given filenames.

methods.name: int createFile(const char * file_name)
methods.description: Creates an empty file with the specified filename.

methods.name: int eraseTGZItemsMatching(const char * folder,const char * file_name)
methods.description: Deletes files in a directory matching a filename pattern and extension .tgz.

methods.name: unsigned int getFreeSpace(char * path)
methods.description: Returns free disk space in MB for a given mounted directory path.

methods.name: unsigned int checkFileSystem(char * path)
methods.description: Checks if the filesystem is writable by creating and deleting a test file.

methods.name: int findSize(char * fileName)
methods.description: Returns the size of a file in bytes.

methods.name: int findFile(char * dir,char * search)
methods.description: Recursively searches for a specific file in a directory tree.

methods.name: int findPFile(char * path,char * search,char * out)
methods.description: Recursively searches for a file matching a pattern in directory and subdirectories.

methods.name: int findPFileAll(char * path,char * search,char ** out,int * found_t,int max_list)
methods.description: Recursively finds all files matching a pattern, stores paths in an output list.

methods.name: int isDataInList(char ** pList,char * pData,int count)
methods.description: Checks if a specific string exists within a list of strings.

methods.name: int emptyFolder(char * folderPath)
methods.description: Removes all contents of a directory and deletes subdirectories.

methods.name: int removeFile(char * filePath)
methods.description: Deletes a specified file.

methods.name: int copyFiles(char * src,char * dst)
methods.description: Copies data from source file to destination file.

methods.name: int fileCheck(char * pFilepath)
methods.description: Checks if a file exists.

methods.name: int folderCheck(char * path)
methods.description: Checks if a directory exists.

methods.name: char * getExtension(char * filename)
methods.description: Returns the extension part of a filename.

methods.name: char * getPartStr(char * fullpath,char * delim)
methods.description: Extracts part of a string after a delimiter.

methods.name: char * getPartChar(char * fullpath,char delim)
methods.description: Extracts part of a string after the last occurrence of a character.

methods.name: void copyCommandOutput(char * cmd,char * out,int len)
methods.description: Executes a system command and copies the first line of output into a buffer.

methods.name: int tarExtract(char * in_file,char * out_path)
methods.description: Extracts a tar archive into a specified directory.

methods.name: int arExtract(char * in_file,char * out_path)
methods.description: Extracts an ar archive into a specified directory.

methods.name: unsigned int getFileLastModifyTime(char * file_name)
methods.description: Returns the last modification time of a file.

methods.name: time_t getCurrentSysTimeSec(void)
methods.description: Returns the current system time in seconds.

methods.name: int getProcessID(char * in_file,char * out_path)
methods.description: Finds and returns the PID of a process matching a name.
